reason: Automates workspace session organization by reading visible session content, classifying sessions, renaming titles into Category｜Topic format, and reporting archive suggestions without archiving, deleting, or editing content.

summaries.zh: 通过读取会话内容对工作区会话进行分类，将可见会话重命名为“类别｜主题”格式，并报告归档建议。
summaries.en: Organizes workspace sessions by reading their content, classifying them, renaming visible sessions as Category｜Topic, and reporting archive suggestions.

capabilities: Lists visible workspaces and sessions through a local RPC interface
Reads session history to classify sessions
Reports archive, rename, and judgment suggestions
Uses helper shell and Python scripts for session processing
